rule: Primary papers, institutional/investor/company disclosures and published patents retain source type and access limits. Linked reports of one cohort are not independent replications.

sources.title: Dai et al., Chemogenetic Neuromodulation for Refractory Epilepsy
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Publication identified; direct article and supplement not retrieved by root. Quantitative claims attributed to D02, not represented as a full-article audit.

sources.title: Capital Medical University / Xuanwu Hospital investigator account
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full page read. Three patients; weeks 5-12; 92.6%; background treatment; safety and 12/8/8-month follow-up. Same cohort as D01.

sources.title: CIBR first-human chemogenetic report and program status
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed primary text plus English publication notice. China enrollment and US trial permission remain attributed; regulator letter not inspected.

sources.title: Beijing science authority: GA002 trial launch
sources.source_type: Official authority reproducing CIBR program disclosure
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full page read. Six IIT recipients include three hippocampal-sclerosis patients; not six detailed outcomes or a cohort additive to D01. GA001 optogenetic; GA008 filings were prospective.

sources.title: ZGC investor: GenAns Series A
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed original release read. Several hundred million RMB; no precise amount, valuation, accessible offer or fully funded development assertion.

sources.title: US10525103B2: combined modified-receptor vector and agonist for seizures
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Public document and UCL Business assignee metadata inspected. No claim construction, infringement, license availability or freedom-to-operate conclusion.

sources.title: Perez-Sanchez et al., A humanized chemogenetic system inhibits murine pain-related behavior and hyperactivity in human sensory neurons
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed primary PubMed/PMC article content reviewed; direct PMC access challenged in root. Mouse pain and human-cell work, not treated people. PMID 37792955; PMC7615191.

sources.title: Haroun et al., Chemogenetic Silencing of NaV1.8-Positive Sensory Neurons Reverses Chronic Neuropathic and Bone Cancer Pain
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Primary abstract/article excerpts reviewed. Keep AAV and transgenic contexts and sensory outcomes distinct; PMID 37679042; PMC10523839.

sources.title: Cooper et al., Precision cell-state silencing of injured afferents alleviates spontaneous neuropathic pain
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Title/DOI/date identified in original bioRxiv listing. Full primary preprint not recovered; no quantitative efficacy or specificity claim adopted. Not peer reviewed.

sources.title: Gonzalez-Ramos et al., Chemogenetics with PSAM4-GlyR decreases excitability and epileptiform activity in epileptic hippocampus
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed publisher/PMC body and concluding statements reviewed. In-vivo electrographic seizure suppression not significant despite cell/slice effects. PMC11946892.

sources.title: Collins et al., Encapsulation of AAVs into Protein Vault Nanoparticles as a Novel Solution to Gene Therapy’s Neutralizing Antibody Problem
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed ACS body, comparators and conflict disclosure read; direct publisher opening blocked. Cell transduction in neutralizing mouse serum, not in-vivo therapeutic or human repeat-dose success.

sources.title: PubMed record for the vaultAAV paper
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Metadata and abstract read. Same underlying study as V01, not independent replication.

sources.title: US20250027112A1: Gene therapy delivery compositions and methods of use thereof
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Published document and indexed assignment metadata read. Washington University and later Regents of UC entry; no executed license/current clean-title/FTO opinion. Avoid unverified normalized campus label.

sources.title: Logan Thrasher Collins: Cathedral ownership history
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full page read. Reports March 2025 acquisition by unnamed biotech and reconstituted entity. No independent acquirer, terms or title verification.

sources.title: Cathedral Therapeutics current website
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Current platform and team page read. Marketing claims are not clinical data or validated repeat dosing.

sources.title: Kar et al., Novel CCL21-Vault Nanocapsule Intratumoral Delivery Inhibits Lung Cancer Growth
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full body and figure legends inspected. Ten mice/group in relevant legends; empty-vault/diluent comparison. No free-cargo in-vivo efficacy arm in those contrasts.

sources.title: Voth et al., CCL21-coupled vaults in a glioma model
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Primary abstract reviewed. Flank model, not intracranial disease/BBB demonstration. Ambiguous free-cargo arm punctuation not silently resolved. DOI 10.1007/s11060-020-03479-8.

sources.title: Oh et al., CCL21-modified dendritic cells with pembrolizumab in NSCLC
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full clinical results read. 23 treated, 19 efficacy-evaluable, 0/19 responses, 7/19 stable disease; different product from vaults. NCT03546361.

sources.title: UCLA Health: How a scientist’s lifelong obsession with vaults could transform medicine
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full page read. Historical manufacturing interruption and approximately $10m prospective trial financing need; not a 2026 quote or verified clinical start.

sources.title: Vault Pharma appoints Oliver Foellmer: historical VPI-101 status
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Reviewed in independent vault source pass. Active-ingredient phase I wording and future trial plans do not show vault-treated patients.

sources.title: US11793860B2: cytokine-vault patent family
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Public family/assignee record inspected in independent pass. No legal claim construction, available license or FTO established.

sources.title: Nagasawa et al., NY-ESO-1 vault nanoparticles induce dendritic-cell maturation
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Primary abstract reviewed; murine dendritic-cell maturation, not clinical or tumor efficacy. DOI 10.1007/s11060-020-03472-1. VPI-111 alias not confirmed.

sources.title: Buehler et al., Bioengineered Vaults: Self-Assembling Protein Shell-Lipophilic Core Nanoparticles
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Full text reviewed. Latency/activation biomarkers; human donor cells are not treated patients; no reservoir elimination. DOI 10.1021/nn5002694.

sources.title: Antibody-targeted vault-Z delivery paper
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Independent pass inspected primary article; uptake/fluorescent cargo result. Therapeutic cargo work prospective; PMC11203631.

sources.title: University abstract concerning anti-LADON vault delivery
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Independent pass found a proposed siRNA delivery direction; not treated as verified therapeutic efficacy or an alias of S03.

sources.title: Rutgers S2016-155: retinal DREADD neuropsychiatric approach
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed original listing read; direct page returned 403. Rat light-deprivation behavior and licensing advertised; current availability and exact patent scope not confirmed.

sources.title: Rutgers 2026-025: Chemogenetic Treatment for Neurodegenerative and Neuropsychiatric Disorders
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed original listing read. Similar retinal hM3Dq rationale to W01; not counted as an independent asset or replication. Index/listing dates differ.

sources.title: Rutgers MPS2016-155: intra-ocular neuropsychiatric method / Alzheimer’s-related rat behavior
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Indexed original listing read. Rat learning/memory claims and licensing advertised. No treated-human evidence or independent primary-study audit; relationship to W01/W02 and current rights unconfirmed.

sources.title: NCT06596681: unresolved GA pain registry lead
sources.source_type: Primary registry location; unverified structured record
sources.access_and_claim_limits: Registry page exposed only interface text. GA pain identity is a provisional discovery label, not verified mapping to GA008/GA002; no recruitment, enrollment or outcome claim adopted.
